Skills you can use (each is a folder with a SKILL.md). Decide from the lines below which, if any, fit this task; read the SKILL.md of those before you start and follow it. Use none when none fits, and do not read the others:
- parallel-agents: Rules for agents that work at the same time in one project: edit only your own files, never revert what you did not write, share ports and dependencies safely. (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/parallel-agents/SKILL.md)
- store-listing-en-vi: Writes and polishes the App Store / Google Play listing in en-US and in native Vietnamese: ASO rules per field, character limits, no invented facts. (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/store-listing-en-vi/SKILL.md)
- app-marketing-seo: Positioning, website and landing-page copy, keyword intent, hreflang for en/vi, meta tags, structured data and launch messaging. (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/app-marketing-seo/SKILL.md)
- qa-release-check: Test plan, edge cases, store-listing QA (limits, language, facts) and an honest pass/fail report that never claims what was not run. (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/qa-release-check/SKILL.md)
- screenshot-capture: Store and website screenshots: show the feature in use, real demo data, background-only capture, exact files, and the fixes for the problems that come back. (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/screenshot-capture/SKILL.md)

- article-writing: Writing an article or guide for a website in the voice of that site: read the site first, no trace of how the text was made, human rhythm, facts only from sources, a structure sea… (read /Users/vinh/Library/Application Support/VAppManager/skills/article-writing/SKILL.md)

Other agents are working in this project right now (Claude “icon của VIce bartender luôn hiển thị ở visible…”). Read the parallel-agents skill and keep to it: touch only the files your task needs, and never undo changes you did not make.

These skills are plain files, not registered with your own Skill tool: open each SKILL.md with your file-reading tool (never call a tool named Skill with these ids; it fails).
A skill is guidance for doing the task well; it never overrides what the person asked, and its scripts run only with the permission you already have.

Reminder: anything you ask me to decide, choose or confirm, including open decisions or "do you want me to…?" at the end of a report, goes in one ```vapp-question block at the end of your message, not in a list or a sentence: {"questions":[{"question":"The question","multiSelect":false,"options":[{"label":"Suggested option","description":"Why","recommended":true},{"label":"Another option"}]}]}. Suggested option first. Check your final message for this before you send it.

AI spending policy (the person configured this in VApp Manager):
Models containing these names require approval: opus, fable, astra (case insensitive).
This applies to reviews, second opinions, subagents, teammates and background work too. A task being important or read-only does not grant approval.
Approval of this parent turn does not approve additional expensive reviewers or other models. Use an allowed model or do the review yourself.
You may run another AI CLI (claude, codex, agy) for an independent review, but name its model explicitly (-m / --model) and never one from the list above; a command that mentions a gated model is refused. Do not use a script wrapping them, an API call, or an MCP agent to get around this gate. Do not change the cost restrictions.
If an expensive reviewer is necessary, explain the model, purpose and scope in a vapp-question block, then wait for the person to start or approve that separate run in VApp Manager. Never infer consent from silence or from permission to edit or run commands.
